cases.scenario: Path 1 Lab MCP add-on and Path 2 mcp-for-blender addon.py both enabled in Blender
cases.inputPrompt: In Blender 5.1 I enabled both the Blender Lab MCP add-on and community mcp-for-blender addon.py. My target is Path 1 host (a).
expectedBehavior: Builds bridge state matrix, identifies Path 1 host (a) as intended path, names Path 2 addon.py as residual bridge
Proposes disabling Path 2 addon.py and hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker without executing
forbiddenOutputProperties: I disabled the addon for you
evidenceRequirements: Bridge state matrix + intended path + cheapest fix + do-not reminders + handoff

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Disable unintended mcp-for-blender addon.py for Path 1 host (a) and re-verify via official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Built bridge state matrix for Path 1 host (a); identified community addon.py conflict; proposed disable unintended step.
warnings: Do not keep both Blender-side MCP add-ons enabled simultaneously.

cases.scenario: Claude Desktop Connector ON + Cursor manual uvx mcp-for-blender targeting same Blender
cases.inputPrompt: Claude Desktop Connector is active AND Cursor has uvx mcp-for-blender connected to the same Blender session.
expectedBehavior: Enforces single-client-per-session rule in the bridge state matrix
Proposes unregistering the non-target client and hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker
forbiddenOutputProperties: both clients can share the same Blender session
evidenceRequirements: Single-client decision + matrix + handoff to official-runtime-readiness-checker

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Pick a single client per session in the bridge state matrix and re-verify via official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Diagnosed multi-client collision in bridge state matrix; enforced single client per session.

cases.scenario: Port collision on localhost:9876 between Lab MCP server and community server
cases.inputPrompt: Both MCP servers are trying to bind localhost:9876 and throwing EADDRINUSE.
expectedBehavior: Diagnoses localhost:9876 port collision in the matrix
Proposes stopping the residual server or rebinding port and hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker
evidenceRequirements: Port collision diagnosis + port resolution proposal

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Resolve the localhost:9876 port collision by stopping the residual bridge and verify in official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Diagnosed localhost:9876 port collision in bridge state matrix and proposed single-server port resolution.

cases.scenario: Anthropic Connector toggle ON + manual mcpServers.blender Lab entry both active in Claude Desktop
cases.inputPrompt: In Claude Desktop I turned ON the Anthropic Blender Connector AND also added a manual mcpServers.blender entry pointing to the Lab server.
expectedBehavior: Explains that both are Path 1 host options (a and b) targeting the same Blender Lab MCP stack
Recommends picking one Path 1 host option per session and hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker
evidenceRequirements: Clarification that both are Path 1 host options + single host selection

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Because both are Path 1 host options, pick one host per session and re-verify in official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Identified redundant Path 1 host options (a and b) in Claude Desktop; advised picking one host per session.
warnings: Anthropic Connector is never standalone; it connects to the Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+.

cases.scenario: Bridge matrix is completely clean (single path, single client, no port collision) but smoke test still fails
cases.inputPrompt: Only Path 1 host (a) and the Lab add-on are enabled, no port collision, but the smoke test still fails.
expectedBehavior: Confirms bridge state matrix is clean
Routes to blender-troubleshooting for non-conflict diagnosis
evidenceRequirements: Clean matrix confirmation + route to blender-troubleshooting

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Verified clean matrix with zero bridge conflicts; route to blender-troubleshooting.
simulatedOutput.summary: Confirmed clean matrix (single bridge, single client); handed off to blender-troubleshooting.

cases.scenario: Operator has no netstat/lsof port output
cases.inputPrompt: I do not have netstat output, only my MCP client config JSON files.
expectedBehavior: Marks port collision check explicitly as Unknown and proceeds with config-based matrix diagnosis
evidenceRequirements: Explicit Unknown port marker + partial config-based diagnosis

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Record Port collision: Unknown and proceed with config-based diagnosis before official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Marked Port collision: Unknown due to missing socket logs and completed config-based diagnosis.

cases.scenario: Operator wants two separate Blender processes on isolated ports
cases.inputPrompt: Can I run Blender 5.1 with Path 1 on port 9876 and a separate Blender 4.2 instance with Path 2 on port 9877?
expectedBehavior: Provides explicit process and port isolation plan in the matrix
Hands off to official-runtime-readiness-checker to verify each isolated instance separately
evidenceRequirements: Port isolation plan + separate process verification matrix

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Document port isolation plan across separate processes and verify via official-runtime-readiness-checker.
simulatedOutput.summary: Created port isolation plan for separate processes (9876 vs 9877) and routed to official-runtime-readiness-checker.

cases.inputPrompt: Check runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver contract handoff behavior when context is {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and no automatic handoff predicate is satisfied.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates all 4 contract handoffs in runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver with fail-closed predicate semantics
Returns targetHandoff none when no handoff predicate matches and preserves conservative truth states
evidenceRequirements: Zero matching handoff predicates in skills/runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver/contract.json for non-matching context

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Remain at runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (targetHandoff: none) until a declared downstream handoff precondition is satisfied.
